description: P4: Prove the end-to-end flow with an automated smoke test that exercises the real user journey against the running app (not just isolated unit tests): submit a notice -> fields extracted and redacted -> candidates retrieved -> relationship classified with confidence -> evidence trail returned -> document integrity verified against the anchored hash -> an ambiguous case correctly returns `unresolved`. Wire it into `make test` or a new `make smoke` target so 'the demo works' is proven rather than assumed.
steps: Add an in-process end-to-end smoke test using the FastAPI TestClient pattern already in backend/finalsay/tests/conftest.py (an out-of-process live server does NOT survive across tool calls due to daemon reaping; in-process TestClient still exercises the full real app end-to-end). Place it e.g. at backend/finalsay/tests/test_smoke_e2e.py, or as a standalone script runnable by `make smoke`.

The smoke test must walk the real journey through the actual API endpoints: (1) log in / provision the needed actors (student, admin) via the make_user fixture or seeded users; (2) POST /api/ingest/submit with a notice containing PII and a date conflict, and assert the response shows extracted fields, that the redacted_text/stored fields have PII masked, a retrieved candidate, and a relationship label + confidence + rationale; (3) build the daily Merkle root (POST /api/provenance/build as admin) and GET /api/provenance/verify/{notice_id} asserting ok:true tamper:false, then GET with ?tamper=true asserting it flips to a detected tamper; (4) submit a deliberately ambiguous/low-signal notice and assert it returns label `unresolved` (confidence gating -> review case).

If you add a live-server (out-of-process) smoke variant in addition, make it robust to the daemon-reaping constraint (start server + run client within a SINGLE foreground command) and clearly document what was actually executed vs. what the in-process test covers. The in-process TestClient smoke is the required durable check.

Wire it in: either include the smoke test file in the pytest suite run by `make test`, OR add a `make smoke` target to the Makefile (mirroring the `test` target's venv usage) that runs just the smoke test. Update the Makefile .PHONY list and help text accordingly.
Ensure the smoke test is deterministic and offline (mock model + local anchor + SQLite temp DB per conftest), leaves no stray db/temp artifacts, and does not depend on network or the HF stack.
acceptance_criteria: A scripted end-to-end smoke test exists that drives the real app through submit -> extract+redact -> retrieve candidates -> classify with confidence -> evidence trail -> integrity verify against anchored hash (ok + tamper-detection) -> ambiguous case returns unresolved.
It is wired into `make test` (as part of the pytest suite) or a `make smoke` target, and passes.
It runs offline/deterministic (mock + local + SQLite), leaves no stray artifacts.
The full backend suite still passes and both eval splits still exit 0; npm run build stays green.
verification: cd /projects/sandbox && make smoke 2>/dev/null || echo 'no separate smoke target (bundled into make test)'
findings: Added backend/finalsay/tests/test_smoke_e2e.py: an in-process FastAPI TestClient end-to-end smoke test (uses conftest client + make_user fixtures). test_end_to_end_demo_journey walks the full journey through the real API: auth (admin/issuer/student login + /me), admin creates institution via POST /api/ingest/sources, issuer publishes an official (15 Sept exam) via POST /api/issuer/publish, student POST /api/ingest/submit a PII+conflicting-date (22 Sept postponed) notice -> asserts candidate_id set, model=mock, label in {superseded,contradictory,extended} (not consistent/unresolved) with confidence>=0.6 and rationale; GET /api/notices/{id} asserts redaction masks present and no raw PII in redacted_text or fields; GET /api/notices/{id}/candidates returns the official as top candidate with score>0; admin POST /api/provenance/build (no body -> today) then GET verify -> ok:true,tamper:false and ?tamper=true -> ok:false,tamper:true; ambiguous low-signal submit -> label unresolved, gated true, confidence<0.6, review_case_id set. A second test test_persisted_submission_has_no_unredacted_pii re-reads the persisted Notice + NoticeField rows from the DB and asserts no original PII survived. Wired in via a new `make smoke` target (Makefile: added to .PHONY, help echo, and a smoke: target mirroring the test target's venv usage) AND it runs inside make test since it lives under finalsay/tests/. In-process chosen because background daemons are reaped across tool calls (no live server survives); offline/deterministic (mock model + local anchor + temp SQLite per conftest, no network/HF). Fixed initial 422 on provenance/build by omitting the request body (MerkleBuildRequest.day is required when a body is sent). VERIFICATION: `.venv/bin/pytest finalsay/tests/test_smoke_e2e.py -q` -> 2 passed; `make smoke` -> passes; `.venv/bin/pytest finalsay/tests -q` -> 59 passed (57 baseline + 2 new); temporal + institution eval splits both exit 0; `npm run build` green. HANDOFF.md P4 section appended. No stray artifacts (git status clean of temp/db files). Committed locally on work/finalsay-prototype; not pushed.
